description: RECORDS a completed sale as a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record used for filings. Supply the `calculation_id` returned by numeral_calculate_tax and your `reference_order_id`. Numeral: POST /tax/transactions.

calculation_id.description: The calculation id returned by numeral_calculate_tax.

reference_order_id.description: Your order id for this sale (used for record keeping / dedupe).

transaction_processed_at.description: Unix timestamp (SECONDS) the sale was processed. Defaults to now if omitted.

name: numeral_create_transaction
title: Create transaction
